about: Nordic brews. Bought with points at the shrine; the blessing takes effect at once. They stack: take each as often as you can pay for. Death takes them all. Each class has its own three (cls), offered only to that class at the altar; the rest are shared.

rows.label: Troll's Hide Mead
rows.description: +100 maximum health per drink.

rows.label: Quicksilver Draught
rows.description: Your spells cost 15% less magicka per drink (up to 75% less).

rows.label: Twin Strike Ale
rows.description: Your spells deal 50% more damage per drink.

rows.label: Hearthfire Tonic
rows.description: Saves you from one death: instead of dying, you get back up. Each tonic is one save.

rows.label: Windrunner Brew
rows.description: You move faster and can sprint longer. Each brew adds more.

rows.label: Hawkeye Tincture
rows.description: Your magicka refills 50% faster per drink.

rows.label: Mammoth Back Porter
rows.description: +50 maximum magicka per drink.

rows.label: Frostbite Venom
rows.description: When an enemy hits you, frost webs burst out and slow every enemy nearby. Each drink makes the webs wider and colder.

rows.label: Stormcrown Cider
rows.description: Every 12th spell you cast sends out a lightning burst around you. Each cider makes it come sooner and hit harder.

rows.label: Fletcher's Sap Draught
rows.description: Your arrows and bolts slowly grow back in your quiver. Each drink makes them grow back faster.

rows.label: Bonebinder's Brew
rows.description: Your summons have 50% more health and deal 50% more damage.

rows.label: Soul-Tether Wine
rows.description: Each time one of your summons kills an enemy, you heal 5% of your maximum health.

rows.label: Conjurer's Command Mead
rows.description: You can have one more summon out at a time (up to 7).

rows.label: Ember Heart Ale
rows.description: Enemies you kill with Destruction spells explode, hurting the enemies around them.

rows.label: Arcanist's Focus Tea
rows.description: Destruction spells cost 25% less magicka.

rows.label: Mana-Siphon Draught
rows.description: Each kill with a Destruction spell gives you back 6% of your magicka.

rows.label: Eagle-Eye Draught
rows.description: You draw bows and reload crossbows 25% faster.

rows.label: Dawnwatch Tonic
rows.description: While you hold a bow or crossbow, enemies' hits do 25% less damage to you.

rows.label: Bladesong Mead
rows.description: Each melee hit you land on an enemy heals you 2% of your maximum health.

rows.label: Spellbinder's Draught
rows.description: Each melee kill gives you back 10% of your magicka.

rows.label: Steel-Wind Ale
rows.description: Your melee attacks are 20% faster.
